name: Clip-on Cable Label
description: A C-clip that snaps sideways onto a cable, carrying a text label. Printed with the cable axis vertical so every layer is a complete C and the clip flexes within its layers. Three styles: a flat flag tag, the same tag with text on both faces, or a wrap band with the text running along the cable. Text is inlaid flush in a second colour.
source: inspired by MakerWorld Configurable cable label / Printables KLAMMA cable label
